title: Sloth in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='8' y='68' width='84' height='6' rx='3' fill='#a0703c'/>
  <rect x='8' y='68' width='84' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c98e52'/>
  <!-- front arm hanging over branch -->
  <path d='M30 60 Q26 70 32 74 Q38 76 40 70 L42 62 Z' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <path d='M30 60 Q26 70 32 74' fill='none' stroke='#b08a63' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='22' ry='17' fill='#a4805c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#c9a878'/>
  <!-- back arm -->
  <path d='M68 58 Q72 68 66 72' fill='none' stroke='#8a6a4a' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- leg dangling -->
  <path d='M42 68 Q40 78 46 82' fill='none' stroke='#8a6a4a' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='82' r='4' fill='#6f533a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#b08a63'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#e8d3b0'/>
  <!-- brow patches -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='26' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#7a5c40'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='26' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#7a5c40'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='31' rx='3.5' ry='3' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='31' rx='3.5' ry='3' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#fff4dd'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#fff4dd'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='3' ry='2.4' fill='#4a3423'/>
  <!-- gentle smile -->
  <path d='M46 40 Q50 43 54 40' fill='none' stroke='#7a5c40' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='28' r='3.5' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='28' r='3.5' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M34 44 Q50 52 66 44 L66 50 Q50 58 34 50 Z' fill='#e0503f'/>
  <path d='M34 44 Q50 52 66 44' fill='none' stroke='#ff7d68' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M60 50 Q64 58 58 64 L52 62 Q57 56 54 49 Z' fill='#c53f30'/>
  <path d='M60 50 Q64 58 58 64' fill='none' stroke='#ff7d68' stroke-width='1.2'/>
</svg>
